recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the core FHIR-37359 cleanup without changing the later FHIR-46191 linkId rule; SDC-specific guidance and extension-pack compatibility content should remain outside this core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-37359 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. The issue asked how users of the Questionnaire regex validation extension could provide a user-facing error message, and FHIR-I resolved to remove the core regex extension and direct systems to ElementDefinition.constraint or the equivalent SDC Questionnaire.item mechanism.
initial_application: Commit acd5de4a3e applied FHIR-37359 by removing regex from the element-extensions profile introduction and spreadsheet. Current source/fhir.ini keeps both Questionnaire and the element-extensions spreadsheet in the active build, and the active element-extension source no longer defines regex.
additional_context: A later Applied Questionnaire issue, FHIR-46191, reintroduced one active reference to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/regex on Questionnaire.item.linkId while also adding the que-16 constraint with the same regular expression and a human message. The FHIR Extension Pack keeps StructureDefinition/regex only as a retired/deprecated compatibility artifact, and related Zulip discussion points implementers to the constraint/invariant approach for custom messages.
reconciliation: Removed only the stale regex extension instance from source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml. The que-16 constraint remains, so the linkId whitespace rule continues to be enforced using ElementDefinition.constraint rather than the removed regex extension.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml: removed the http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/regex extension from Questionnaire.item.linkId and left the que-16 constraint intact.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Questionnaire.item.linkId work reintroduced the stale regex extension reference but also added the que-16 constraint preserved by this fix.
Mentioned in the Zulip follow-up as an SDC issue for regex/constraint guidance; it is outside this core source decision.
Implemented in the same later commit as FHIR-46191 but concerned Questionnaire.item.definition cardinality, not regex validation.
